content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge treats the Romans 1:3 descent evidence against the conception evidence as underdetermined for lack of an explicit textual resolution, which is the stating-verse mode K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"without explicit textual resolution of paternity","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test ... retires' — I weighed whether this bars requiring an explicit verse to resolve paternity (yes) versus merely barring a verse-by-verse contrary check while still allowing an underdetermination finding (no).","why":"The judge labels the issue underdetermined because there is no explicit textual resolution of paternity, which is the retired stating-verse test rather than a chain-by-footing comparison."}
